Metadata.title: Next.js 16 i18n Starter - Multilingual Template by s0vers
Metadata.description: Next.js 16 internationalization starter with next-intl 4. Locale-driven currency, dates, and time zones for Arabic, Chinese, English, Spanish, and Japanese. Includes shadcn UI and RTL support.

SeoGuide.title: Prepare this starter for launch
SeoGuide.description: Before publishing a fork, give search engines and visitors accurate information about your site.
SeoGuide.step1Description: Set NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL to your production HTTPS origin. Canonical links, language alternates, the sitemap, and social previews use this value.
SeoGuide.step2Description: Update the site name, author and social links, localized page titles and descriptions, and the Open Graph image for your project.
SeoGuide.step3Description: Inspect each language version, sitemap.xml, robots.txt, and structured data after deployment. Submit the sitemap in search webmaster tools.

Localization.title: Locale-Driven Formatting
Localization.description: Format prices and dates with next-intl. Each locale sets currency and time zone via getRequestConfig in src/i18n/request.ts.
Localization.switchLanguageHint: Switch language in the header to see currency, dates, and relative time update automatically.
